sections.heading: Sharing the road: second part — B
sections.markdown:
Audience and scope: sharing the road: second part within the selected first-time passenger-car knowledge preparation path. This is an authoring scope from the pinned run configuration.
Coverage plan: Large-vehicle blind spots; Emergency vehicles and moving over; Slow vehicles and rural roads. These are authored organizational labels, with no official examination weighting or eligibility assertion.
All extracted passenger-driver duties about large-vehicle no-zones, stopping examples, emergency response, Ohio moving-over, slow-vehicle passing and rural equipment are represented. The claim about every other state's move-over law is outside Ohio scope and is not promoted. The next-page navigation contains no additional rule. No blind-spot graphic is reproduced.
